thread:
Ava (Product): Heads-up — sprint planning blocker: onboarding checklist for 'aurora-lite' candidate. Need to finalize launch gates and pin policy for customers who requested a stable pin. Perf link: https://ci.redwood/perf/aurora-lite-iter3
Rory (Eng Runtime): TL;DR: throughput OK but P95 spikes on 90th percentile small-GPU workloads, cold-starts amplify it.
Jin (ML): quality looks fine on single-turns but we see regressions on few-shot instruction-following slices (esp. with long prompts).
Sam (Solutions): several customers demanded a deterministic migration path and a pin TTL before they opt in. No TTL = no opt-in.
Ava (Product): proposal: two-tier pin states in catalog: "soft-pin" (90-day TTL, canary allowed) and "hard-pin" (customer-managed pin, indefinite). Reconciliation?
Rory (Eng Runtime): implementable. Soft-pin would be routing + metadata TTL. Need rollout playbook: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback triggers.
Jin (ML): require eval artifacts as gate: regression digest + top-10 failure examples for customer review. I'll own that.
CI Bot: perf-run completed: aurora-lite iter3 dedicated_worst P95=375ms; baseline P95=310ms. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/perf/1714001111
Sam (Solutions): incentive proposal: 30% credits for 8 weeks + one-week dedicated onboarding support. Keep initial cohorts tiny (<=3 customers).
Nora (Customer Ops): two enterprise customers asked for 120-day grace vs our 90d. They want automated rollback and isolated routing during migration windows.
Ava (Product): compromise: soft-pin TTL default 90 days; enterprise can request 120-day extension via Customer Ops. Require engineering to deliver migration runbook within 30 days of extension approval.
Rory (Eng Runtime): add to playbook: perf baseline diff, cache warmness check, kernel compatibility matrix, and SDK compatibility tests. Also outline compat-shim fallback if quantized kernels fail.
Jin (ML): quick quant note: 8-bit quant ~0.6% drop on inst-follow; 4-bit ~3.5% drop. Recommend 8-bit by default for dedicated; 4-bit as labelled cost-optional.
Sam (Solutions): I'll draft customer comms + migration FAQ. Need a sample migration script showing re-pin and rollback commands.
Ava (Product): action items: Rory estimate playbook & shim effort; Jin produce regression digest & eval slices; Sam/Nora draft comms and negotiate enterprise TTLs. Reconvene Mon 10am to finalize gates and roadmap item.
Rory (Eng Runtime): ETA: playbook draft 3 days; compat-shim roadmap 2 sprints.
Jin (ML): uploading eval slices today, will post links here.
Sam (Solutions): comms draft will include sample migration script, SLA adjustments, and cost comparison table.
Ava (Product): adding to roadmap as 'aurora-lite — soft-pin launch window Q2'. Marking this thread canonical for the onboarding + pin negotiation. :rocket:
